limitations: This is not a complete 197-flag registry.
Help presence is not proof that a model will fit or load.
Fit estimates or fitted arguments are not measured token throughput.
No fitting command is executed by the read-only ATYL probe.

entries.semantics: Controls adjustment of unset arguments to fit available device memory.
When on, prints estimated memory information instead of the default fitted-CLI-arguments output.
Target memory margin per device, expressed in MiB; values may be supplied as a sequence.
Lower context-size bound used by the fit process.
GGUF model input path for a future fit operation; not supplied during help probing.
Requested context length, subject to fit constraints.
Selects offload devices; does not prove device kernel support.
Initial offloaded layer count; fitting may alter placement.
Tensor split policy across devices; fitting may propose a changed split.
Specifies tensor buffer placement overrides; fitting can emit related CLI arguments.
Keeps supported MoE expert weights on CPU when applicable.
Controls number of MoE expert layers kept on CPU when applicable.
Prints GGML-visible devices and exits; not an actual fitting operation.
